title: Water rate increases and $19.80 top tier
summary: The budget director said Water Department changes cut the council's budget projections by 13.9 million, all in the water fund. The committee also reworded the water usage tiers so the ranges no longer overlap, with rates unchanged. Earlier, testifiers opposed the proposed water rate increases, citing a top rate of $19.80 per thousand gallons above 50,000 gallons and high bills after unread meters.
